ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a circle with F as the center, and points J, K, G, M are on the circle. On the left side there is vertical line segment JG, a horizontal line passes through H, F, L, and there is a right-angle mark at H, indicating that JH is perpendicular to FH. In the figure, this segment FH is labeled 8. The problem gives FK = 17. Reasoning: Because this is circle F, F is the center of the circle, and FK is a radius, the radius of the circle is 17. Point J is on the circle, so FJ is also a radius, FJ = 17. In right triangle FHJ, ∠FHJ is a right angle, FH = 8, and hypotenuse FJ = 17. By the Pythagorean theorem, JH = sqrt(FJ^2 - FH^2) = sqrt(17^2 - 8^2) = sqrt(289 - 64) = sqrt(225) = 15.

raw_record.question_text:
In $\odot F, \overline{F H} \cong \overline{F L}$ and $\mathrm{FK}=17$.
Find JH.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at F. The left vertical segment JG is perpendicular to the horizontal radius line at H, and the label 8 is on segment FH. From the text, FK = 17, so every radius of circle F is 17; hence FJ = 17. Use right triangle FHJ with right angle at H: FH = 8 and hypotenuse FJ = 17. Apply the Pythagorean theorem to get JH = sqrt(17^2 - 8^2) = sqrt(289 - 64) = 15.

method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that the vertical chords JG and KM are perpendicular to the horizontal line through F at H and L, respectively, and FH is labeled 8. From the text, FH congruent FL, so FL = 8. Since FK = 17 is a radius, use right triangle FLK: KL = sqrt(17^2 - 8^2) = 15. Because the two chords are the same distance from the center F, chords JG and KM are congruent; also, a perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects the chord. Therefore the half-chords are equal, so JH = KL = 15.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 F 为圆心的圆，左侧有竖直弦 JG，右侧有竖直弦 KM。水平线段从左侧弦上的 H 经过圆心 F 到右侧弦上的 L，且在 H、L 处都有直角标记，表示 JG 和 KM 都垂直于这条水平线。图中 FH 标为 8，FK 是从圆心 F 到圆上点 K 的斜线半径。推理：题目给出 FH ≅ FL，所以 FL = FH = 8。又因为 FK = 17 是圆的半径，在直角三角形 FLK 中，FK 是斜边，FL = 8，因此 KL = sqrt(17^2 - 8^2) = sqrt(289 - 64) = sqrt(225) = 15。由于 FH = FL，说明两条弦 JG 和 KM 到圆心 F 的距离相等，所以这两条弦全等。圆心到弦的垂线平分弦，因此 H 和 L 分别是弦 JG、KM 的中点，对应半弦相等，所以 JH = KL = 15。
